entities.summary: Pamela Carolina David Gutiérrez Spanish pronunciation: [paˈmela ðaˈβið]) is an Argentinian television personality, presenter, voice actress and model. She found fame in the reality TV show El BarTV 2. She currently works as a co-hostess on América TV's Desayuno Americano.
